info.name: BlueConic REST API v2 Audit Events Segments API

params.name: segment
params.description: The ID of the segment.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Defines the starting point of the page for pagination. When cursors are used, each page, except the last page, returns a `nextCursor` value which can be used to retrieve the next page.

params.name: count
params.description: Specifies the number of results to return. Smaller than or equal to 1.000.000.

params.name: maxHitsAllowed
params.description: When greater than 0, enables fast approximate export by limiting total hits and using segment count from cache. Use with count for consistent paging (e.g. maxHitsAllowed=200 and count=20 for max 10 pages).

params.name: properties
params.description: Specifies which profile properties values will be returned for each profile. If not specified, the values of all profile properties will be returned, which may result in a large result set. One or more profile property ids, separated by a comma.

params.name: profileProperty
params.description: When the profileProperty is specified, the response will only return the values for the given profile property. If not specified, the values of all profile properties will be returned, which may result in a large result set.

params.name: groupProperty
params.description: When the groupProperty is specified, the response will only return the values for the given group property. If not specified, the values of all group properties will be returned, which may result in a large result set. Only relevant when `&expand=profiles.profile.groups` is supplied.

params.name: refinement
params.description:
**Refinement**

Specifies (URL-encoded) the refinement used to filter profiles. If not specified, all profiles of the given segment will be returned.

To filter profiles using refinements you can use the query parameter refinement. The refinement parameter is a URL-encoded JSON object that contains the refinement in the form of one or more filters.

**Logical operators**

The logical operators used when combining multiple filters.

| Name                    | Description |
| :---------------------- | :---------- |
| AND                     | All filters should match |
| OR                      | Any of the filters should match |

**Operators**

The operators used to filter the property or objectives within a profile.

| Name                    | Description |
| :---------------------- | :---------- |
| IS_EMPTY                | If the given property value is empty | 
| NOT_IS_EMPTY            | If the given property value is not empty |
| CONTAINS_ANY            | If the given property value contains any of the given values |
| CONTAINS_ALL            | If the given property value contains all of the given values |
| NOT_CONTAINS_ANY        | If the given property value does not contain any of the given values |
| NOT_CONTAINS_ALL        | If the given property value does not contain all of the given values |
| IN_RANGE                | If the given property value is in the given range |
| NOT_IN_RANGE            | If the given property value is not in the given range |
| IN_LAST_DAYS            | If the given property value is in the last given number of days |
| NOT_IN_LAST_DAYS        | If the given property value is not in the last given number of days |
| IN_NEXT_DAYS            | If the given property value is in the next given number of days |
| NOT_IN_NEXT_DAYS        | If the given property value is not in the next given number of days |
| IN_LAST_HOURS           | If the given property value is in the last given number of hours |
| NOT_IN_LAST_HOURS       | If the given property value is not in the last given number of hours |
| IN_NEXT_HOURS           | If the given property value is in the next given number of hours |
| NOT_IN_NEXT_HOURS       | If the given property value is not in the next given number of hours |

**Objective**

The objectives used to filter the property or objectives within a profile.

| Name                    | Description |
| :---------------------- | :---------- |
| CONSENTED               | Objective consented |
| REFUSED                 | Objective refused |
| UNKNOWN                 | Unknown |
| REFUSED_OR_UNKNOWN      | Refused or unknown | 
| CONSENTED_OR_UNNEEDED   | Consented or unneeded |

Can only be used with the operators CONTAINS_ANY and CONTAINS_ALL

params.name: expand
params.description: Expand the information in the result set. Use `profiles.profile.permissions` to include permission level. Use `profiles.profile.replace` to include profile merge information. Use `profiles.profile.segments` to include the segments a profile is part of. Use `profiles.profile.timeline` to include timeline event information. Use `profiles.profile.groups` to include group information.  Use `profiles.profile.matchingGroups` to include matching group information. Use multiple `expand` querystring parameters to return combinations.

params.name: eventTypeId
params.description: Filter for the returned timeline events for specific types. One or more IDs of a timeline event type.

params.name: eventProperty
params.description: When the eventProperty is specified, the response will only return the values for the given property. If not specified, the values of all event properties will be returned, which may result in a large result set.

params.name: eventCount
params.description: The maximum number of timeline events to return.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Filter to only include timeline events that are dated later than this date. In the ISO 8601 format '2025-01-22T11:21:33.872Z' or with time zone offset `2025-01-22T11:21:33.872+05:00`.

params.name: toDate
params.description: Filter to only include timeline events that are dated before this date. In the ISO 8601 format '2025-01-22T11:21:33.872Z' or with time zone offset `2023-01-22T11:21:33.872+05:00`.

params.name: audienceId
params.description: This is used to track if a profile has already been exported to an audience. If a profile has already been exported to this audience then it is only included in the result when there are recent modifications to the given trackProperties.

params.name: autoCommit
params.description: If the exported profiles should be auto-committed to the given audience.

params.name: trackPropertiesModifiedSince
params.description: The date since which the provided trackProperties should have changed.

params.name: trackProperties
params.description: The tracked properties that should be checked for changes since the given trackPropertiesModifiedSince date.

params.name: trackPropertyChangesInNumberOfDays
params.description: The number of days to track property changes.

items.docs: Retrieves the profiles of the segment.

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Specifies the index of the first item to include in the result.

params.name: count
params.description: Specifies the number of results to return.

params.name: filterTag
params.description: When specified, only segments that have at least one matching tag are returned. Multiple values can be provided by repeating the parameter.
